newsitem.title: GERMANY: Mannesmann mobile unit pays first dividend.
newsitem.headline: Mannesmann mobile unit pays first dividend.

text.p: Mannesmann Mobilfunk GmbH, the digital cellular phone operator, said on Tuesday that it would pay its first dividend to shareholders Mannesmann and Airtouch Communications since its launch seven years ago.
The company said in a statement it would pay a dividend totalling 376 million marks ($229 million) on 1996 earnings. It added that it now had 2.3 million subscribers in its D2 cellular phone network.
Mannesmann is the largest shareholder with 65.2 percent and Airtouch Communications of the United States holds 34.8 percent.
-- William Boston, Bonn Newsroom, 49 228 26097150 ($ = 1.640 German Marks)
